name: Rocksteady Climbing
research_notes: Own About page: "Long Island's Premier Indoor Bouldering Space", 6,000+ sq ft of climbable terrain with bouldering walls and 20-ft auto-belays, Tension Board 2 room. Own pricing page: day pass adult $27. Home page: hours Mon 10-23, Tue-Sun 10-22 and four flyers uploaded in October 2026 (youth, training, parties). Climbing Business Journal (2026-07-08) says it was about to open. Pin: Photon geocode of the street address lands on the building way/464210772. The Google embed on the gym site is centred about 800 m from that building, so it is not used.

name: GOAT Climbing Gym
research_notes: Resolves the 2026-10-06-us-northeast deferral of this gym (that pass read only the home page). Home page (fetch tool; plain requests get HTTP 403): 77 River Street, hours Mon-Fri 10-22, Sat 10-20, Sun 10-18, copyright 2026, post stamped 2026-10-03. Own Bouldering Classes page: Bouldering 101 and "Boulder 201 ... best for those climbing V4 to V6" (non-member $30), so the gym has graded boulder problems; the pricing page sells day passes ($28 adult) and a "Boulder Gear Bundle". Climbing Business Journal also describes two floors of bouldering (secondary). No bouldering area size is stated on the pages read. Pin: the gym's own OSM node.

name: MetroRock Tyngsborough
research_notes: Own site: 440 Middlesex Rd, hours Mon-Fri 10-22 and Sat-Sun 9-21, day passes (adult $30), amenities line "Bouldering | 7 Auto Belays | Top Ropes | Lead | Fitness Area | Tension Board 2 | Yoga Studio". The MetroRock chain list names Tyngsborough as the 3rd Massachusetts site. No page carried a 2026 date (open status rests on the current hours and prices only). About 50 km from central Boston, on the outer edge of the metro. Pin: the gym's own OSM way (sports_centre).

research_notes: Youth-oriented gym that also sells a public day pass ($25, "access to all auto belays, top ropes, bouldering, and American Ninja Warrior Challenges"; walk-ins during open hours; hours Mon-Thu 12-19, Fri-Sat 12-18, Sun 10-18) and adult classes. FAQ: bouldering walls and a bouldering cave, graded on the V-scale. Events page: Halloween party on October 23rd and dates up to October 24th (current). Pin: Photon geocode of the street address lands on the building way/77889633 (Wix site has no map coordinates).

name: Boulder Union Climbing and Fitness
research_notes: Own day-pass page: 3,500 sq ft of bouldering, walls about 15 ft, day pass $29, kids day pass. Own home page: hours Mon-Fri 12-22, Sat-Sun 9-21, fall-semester membership "Ends in December". Own location page: 174 Union Street. Outside the 40 km Boston radius (about 85 km south) but inside the section bounding box; same city as Carabiner's Climbing & Fitness (seed-293, 1.3 km away, different name and address). Pin: Nominatim address polygon for 174 Union Street.
